reviews.title: I’ve Pulled My Business From BookiPi
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would. They started out with a great platform and they did the same garbage that QuickBooks did…changed the format making it completely useless in design and structure. Then they force you into the same design as QuickBooks making you feel unheard and worthless. Well screw BookiPi and their heartless deception. I will not give them any more money and I have deleted their app. If I didn’t know better I would swear that they are laying in bed with QuickBooks. There was NO reason to change a format, layout and design that was perfect. Just because something is old doesn’t mean it needs to be changed. Nice to see you are worthless just like your app now. Glad to see your true colors. It’s about the money and not about us people. While you can lie and say you have the best app, that’s a bold face lie. You “USE” to have a great app but now it’s trash. Thanks for not listening to us little people. I hate you for doing what you did; just like QuickBooks but no worries. I have a team working on my own invoice app and I will do everything I can to take your customers and put you out forever. I promise you. I won’t stop till yours gone!

reviews.title: Confusing Mixed Invoices!
reviews.text: The new version or update mixes the unpaid and paid invoices it makes everything confusing I will cancel my subscription and ya’ll should too! unless it gets fixed like it used to.

reviews.title: Recent update
reviews.text: My rating is solely for the recent update - I cant find some options I often use. Its basically just harder to navigate through smh.

reviews.title: I don’t like how you can’t copy your invoices anymore!
reviews.text: I did love this app and then you changed the layout.  Put it back!!!  This is a time waster now!  I pay good money for this app and now it’s a complete waste of time!

reviews.title: WHAT HAPPENED?"
reviews.text: Started charging with no opt out.  Was working fine for yearsi.. went to create an invoice today and it would only give me the option to subscribe for $129 a year and no opt out or ability to continue using the app… total bs

reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text: Sad this was free and they hiked up the price. As a freelancer and using the invoice sparingly during the year doesn't warrent this price. Developers should use the same pricing model as HP Smart printing. Have a set tier price as per the number of invoices used in a given period, and have a rollover option. I may use one invoice a month but maybe 5 the next. I get the creators need to be paid but it seems cheeky to hook you in, then charge you down the line. Couldn't they have advertisers in the app instead of charging users??

reviews.title: FRAUD: If it could be zero, it would - DO NOT USE THEM
reviews.text:
No communication except automated emails & bots.

It is now 27 days since bookipi charged my credit card.  My vendor has STILL not been paid.  Several emails with no response. Multiple automated responses to our inquiries asking for ‘patience’.  A series of emails from both me and the vendor provided full documentation, and resulted in more automated emails with canned responses, asking for patience.  I am going to give up and declare the transaction fraudulent with my credit card, meaning I now have to get a new card issued - thanks bookipi.

reviews.title: Scamming
reviews.text: This app will scam the invoice sender and client with surcharges and fees. My setting are fully set up to make sure the client covers all applicable fees. After some time I noticed that I’m getting charges for those fees. After getting through their annoying “AI help” bot I got ahold of a real person. Basically just giving general statements like “if the customer pays the fees then you won’t” and “make sure your settings are set up correctly”. I sent picture evidence that my setting have been set up properly and ask for them to proved proof that they haven’t been double dipping surcharges. I have been waiting 4 days for a reply which I suspect will never come. STAY AWAY they will scam you. Very tempted to escalate this issue with the banks and have them look into this apps transactions.

reviews.title: Upgrade
reviews.text: It’s a free app, but if it wants to upgrade I can’t even create an invoice.

reviews.title: Sold out
reviews.text: I used to love the ability to estimate and bill clients as a super small business. Not that this company sold it to adds and no longer catering to their small customers I am on the hunt for a new lover of my business. No heads up to the change really told me they donor care

reviews.title: Consistently downgraded
reviews.text:
I have used bookipi since 2020.

They have consistently worsened the app with each addition… It’s weird how much better this was when it was free.

reviews.title: Not Free anymore
reviews.text: Was using this app for a few years, was very happy with it as I don’t send out a lot of invoices but now after the update they £60 a year to do the same thing. Very disappointed by this move. Going to be using another app now.

reviews.title: Updates
reviews.text: App updates are making it more tedious to generate an invoice. Within last year, the number of steps touches, and time needed to generate an invoice has dramatically increased. Thinking of changing to an another app. Usually latest update is giving me a rage.

reviews.title: Deleted costumers
reviews.text: This new update deleted all customers and previous invoices

reviews.title: Long time user paid for 12 mths upgraded and its now a different app that I cannot log into
reviews.text: Disappointed that this started out as a free to use low user app that then charged me 59.99 for 12 Mth then a few months later it asked me to update the app which I’ve just done and now it’s not recognising my log in … which is costing me money not being able to invoice my work. I’m now losing confidence in this app
